user.title: AutoShuttersControl for HA
user.description: One setup for all covers. Choose the global sensors now; everything else is in the options. Add covers and profiles afterwards with the buttons of the integration.

data_description.workday_sensor: Binary sensor of the Workday integration. Without a sensor Monday to Friday are workdays.
data_description.workday_tomorrow_sensor: Workday integration with a days offset of 1. Without a sensor Monday to Friday are workdays.
data_description.calendar: Used when the times come from the calendar.
data_description.brightness_sensor: Illuminance in lx, for the modes Brightness and the privacy by brightness.

abort.single_instance_allowed: AutoShuttersControl is already set up. Add covers and profiles to the existing entry.

init.title: Global settings
init.description: These values apply to all covers unless a profile or the cover sets its own value.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Morning and evening drive. Sun: the sun event plus offset, kept between the earliest and the latest time. Time: at the earliest time.

data.horizon_up: Own sun elevation in the morning
data.horizon_down: Own sun elevation in the evening

data_description.up_mode: Time: at the earliest opening time. Sun: at the sun event.
data_description.down_mode: Time: at the earliest closing time. Sun: at the sun event.
data_description.offset_up: Minutes added to the sun event; negative is earlier.
data_description.offset_down: Minutes added to the sun event; negative is earlier.
data_description.down_tomorrow_workday: The evening uses the times of tomorrow, e.g. the day-off times on Friday evening.
data_description.time_source: Calendar: an event whose title contains the text below sets the earliest (start) and latest (end) time of that day. Days without an event use the times.

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: Sensors used by all covers. A profile or a cover can use its own sensor instead.

data_description.workday_sensor: Binary sensor of the Workday integration. Without a sensor Monday to Friday are workdays.
data_description.workday_tomorrow_sensor: Workday integration with a days offset of 1. Without a sensor Monday to Friday are workdays.
data_description.calendar: Used when the times come from the calendar.
data_description.brightness_sensor: Illuminance in lx, for the modes Brightness and the privacy by brightness.

data_description.pos_comfort: Used for a fully open window while the switch Comfort is on.
data_description.pos_privacy_up: Empty: same as the evening privacy position.
data_description.tolerance: A cover within this distance of a position counts as being there.

drive.title: Drive behaviour
drive.description: Delays and rules for every drive.

data_description.delay_fixed: Seconds to wait before a scheduled drive.
data_description.delay_random: Up to this many seconds are added at random, so that not all motors start together.
data_description.drive_time: Time for a full run. Position reports during this time after our own command count as our drive.
data_description.open_never_down: No morning drive if the cover is already further open.
data_description.close_never_up: No evening drive if the cover is already further closed.

override.title: Manual override
override.description: A drive that did not come from AutoShuttersControl (button, app, wall switch) starts a manual override.

data.manual_counts_open: Opening by hand counts as morning drive
data.manual_counts_close: Closing by hand counts as evening drive

data_description.override_blocks: These drives wait until the override ends.
data_description.override_return: When the override ends the cover drives to its current target.
data_description.manual_counts_open: Opened by hand between the earliest opening and the scheduled time: no further morning drive that day.
data_description.manual_counts_close: Closed by hand between the earliest closing and the scheduled time: no further evening drive that day.

reset.title: Reset fields
reset.description: The chosen fields go back to the default value.

light.title: Brightness and sun elevation
light.description: For the modes Brightness and Sun elevation: the cover opens as soon as it is bright enough between the earliest and the latest opening time, at the latest time at the latest. Closing works the same way.

data.light_logic: Brightness and sun elevation combined with

data_description.light_logic: Only for the mode "Brightness and sun elevation".
data_description.brightness_duration: Against short changes, e.g. clouds or headlights.
data_description.elevation_source: Fixed: the values below. Sensor: the value of the sensor. Sensor + offset: sensor value plus the values below.
data_description.elevation_sensor: Sensor, number or input_number with a sun elevation in degrees.

window.title: Window contacts
window.description: Ventilation when the window is tilted, comfort when it is open, and lock-out protection for doors.

data_description.window_value_open: For a window sensor with three states.
data_description.window_value_tilted: For a window sensor with three states.
data_description.ventilate_enabled: Drive to the ventilation position when the window is tilted or open.
data_description.ventilate_only_up: Opening the window never lowers the cover.
data_description.window_open_delay: Seconds the contact must stay open (against fluttering).
data_description.window_close_delay: Seconds the contact must stay closed.
data_description.window_close_return: Only after a ventilation drive or a closing that waited for the door.
data_description.lockout: Soft or hard: the cover does not close while the door is open and closes when the door is closed. Hard additionally locks the actuator (stage 4).

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Before the evening drive the cover goes to the privacy position, before the morning drive to the morning privacy position.

data_description.privacy_brightness: Empty = off. Starts the evening privacy after the earliest closing time as soon as it is this dark.
